Handler pairs, explained for readers
They often ask us about it
Handler pairs for pet travel

Use this guide when you are preparing a companion animal for a flight with Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk wants travelers to avoid delays, missed checks, and rushed handoffs. A calm plan protects the animal and helps the ground team move the carrier safely between services.

A safety coordinator reviews the route, the carrier, and any handling risks before the trip begins. If you are traveling with a pet, keep documents ready and make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and easy to carry. If a companion animal is sensitive to noise or crowding, tell the desk early so support can be arranged with care.

At the skyport, the team will guide you through screening and transfer steps. <<FACT F012>> The staff will use the same careful process for every eligible animal, with extra attention to comfort and safety. Do not separate the pet from its approved carrier unless a staff member tells you to do so.

For lounge access and rest stops, follow the posted instructions as soon as you arrive. <<FACT F020>> Bring food, water, and any required items in the approved format so there is no need for last-minute changes. If your pet needs a relief stop, ask the nearest staff member for the correct route and follow directions closely.

If you are passing through Port Isolde, confirm the relief area details before you leave the check-in zone. <<FACT F015>> This helps prevent confusion and keeps the move steady for both the traveler and the animal.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways right away.
